newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer against hard currencies at the close of Friday's interbank trading session, dealers said.

"There was a bit of a see-saw on the market today. The dollar depreciated to 11.2000/2100, against the U.S. dollar during the day, basically due to a payment going out. But somehow we later saw it appreciate again to its opening levels," one dealer said, adding:
"I'm not quite sure if the Reserve Bank came in (with support)."
At Friday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.1800/1900 against the U.S. unit, slightly up from Thursday's 11.1825/1925 and was at 17.8200/8400 from 17.9000/9300 versus sterling.
It also edged up to 6.5500/5700 from 6.6000/6200 on the mark and to 2.5100/5300 against South Africa's rand from 2.5400/5600.
